params.name: zip_code
params.description: ZIP code for the delivery address

params.name: usage
params.description: Annual electricity usage in kWh. Must be between 100 and 50000

params.name: 14a_module_1
params.description: Whether to include §14a EnWG Module 1 (Pauschale Netzentgeltreduktion) in the quote. Only applicable to consumption plans; requests for feed-in plans are rejected with `400 BAD_REQUEST`.

params.name: 14a_module_2
params.description: Whether to include §14a EnWG Module 2 (Prozentuale Netzentgeltreduktion) in the quote. Only applicable to consumption plans; requests for feed-in plans are rejected with `400 BAD_REQUEST`.

params.name: is_tax_exempt
params.description: Whether the prospective customer is exempt from VAT. Private operators are typically exempt as Kleinunternehmer under [§ 19 UStG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ustg_1980/__19.html) when their revenue stayed under 25,000 EUR the previous year and stays under 100,000 EUR the current year; companies are not. Only affects feed-in plans. Consumption plans are always quoted inclusive of VAT.

items.docs: Retrieve a quote details by its id. All prices are inclusive of VAT, with one exception: feed-in payouts to a tax-exempt customer (`is_tax_exempt: true`, e.g. a Kleinunternehmer under § 19 UStG) are quoted without VAT, matching what the customer is later credited. The §14a EnWG module options only apply to consumption plans as feed-in plans do not pay grid fees.
